sources.label: Polygon public RPC reads, dual provider (dRPC, publicnode)

reserveReview.rationale: On 2026-10-01 the rendered issuer transparency dashboard publishes chain-level circulation, loan-book collateral and debt, treasury holdings, DAO debt, and unbacked-MAI-handler addresses. This corrects the earlier statement that on-chain reads were the only primary evidence. The dashboard is a partial accounting disclosure rather than a pinned, globally reconciled reserve composition: its Treasury at a Glance collateral and global debt figures differ from the displayed chain loan-book totals, and it separately identifies DAO debt and isolated Fantom liabilities. The historical 2026-09-05 Base/Polygon census remains selected-slices evidence: approximately 2.94 million USD of identifiable collateral and PSM liquidity, unpriced collateral and CelsiusX redemption uncertainty, residual legacy-chain liabilities and collateral, and treasury/dead/bridged balances prevented global normalization. That census spanned multiple blocks; its same-block-per-chain valuation and circulating-liability reconciliation have not been completed. The aggregate category therefore remains 100% unknown for constituent-weight purposes; no new composition percentages or composition date are inferred from the dashboard.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Live-scope on-chain census read 2026-09-05 (issuer registry enumeration, dual-provider public RPC); percentage normalization pending the pinned same-block pass
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The full recorded multi-market crypto-vault category lacks published constituent weights. Within the census, three Polygon markets have no usable price path (dQUICK, KMM LP token, CEL) and stMATIC has no market price, so their collateral is unvalued or floored; the three CelsiusX wrapped markets (cxWETH, cxADA, cxDOGE, about 55k USD at one-to-one underlying parity) carry issuer-bankruptcy redemption uncertainty; and the share of circulating MAI covered by the identifiable pool versus treasury-absorbed or bridged claims is unreconciled at issuer level.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: NC-090: issuer Important Addresses registry accessed 2026-09-30 still identifies Polygon Beefy cUSDC.e and Morpho/Compound USDC PSMs and DAI receipt vaults. Eligibility does not prove positive current holdings. The September 5 multi-block census reports $1,498,827.75 PSM liquidity but no reconciled global reserve denominator. Next evidence: same-block-per-chain asset/receipt/debt reads across live and residual legacy markets, explicit Polygon PoS USDC.e custody path, and liability reconciliation excluding treasury/dead/bridged double counts. Unpriced collateral and unbacked-MAI-handler balances prevent normalization of the partial inventory; no USDC or DAI edge is authorized.
